title: Learning to Use a Translation App
paragraphs: Selama perjalanan kerja ke luar negeri, Farhat kesulitan berkomunikasi dengan staf hotel yang tidak berbicara bahasanya, jadi ia mengeluarkan aplikasi penerjemah di ponselnya sebagai upaya terakhir.

Percobaan pertama menghasilkan kalimat yang terdengar aneh sehingga membuat staf itu tertawa, dan Farhat menyusun ulang permintaannya secara lebih sederhana sebelum mencoba terjemahan lagi, kali ini lebih berhasil.

Menjelang akhir minggu, ia sudah menggunakan aplikasi itu begitu sering hingga mulai mengingat beberapa frasa berguna sendiri, kadang tidak perlu memeriksa aplikasi sama sekali untuk percakapan sederhana.

Farhat kemudian memberi tahu rekan kerjanya bahwa aplikasi itu, sekalipun kadang canggung, memberinya cukup kepercayaan diri untuk menjalani perjalanan yang awalnya ia khawatirkan karena kendala bahasa.
answerKey: During a work trip abroad, Farhat struggles to communicate with a hotel staff member who does not speak his language, so he pulls out a translation app on his phone as a last resort. The first attempt produces an oddly worded sentence that makes the staff member laugh, and Farhat rephrases his request more simply before trying the translation again, this time more successfully. By the end of the week, he has used the app so often that he starts remembering a few useful phrases himself, occasionally not needing to check the app at all for simple exchanges. Farhat later tells his colleague that the app, awkward as it sometimes was, gave him enough confidence to handle a trip he had originally worried about because of the language barrier.
